videos.title: What happens when you eat tofu weekly? 👀
videos.description:
In case you needed a little more motivation to add tofu to your meals! 😉

Cube ‘em, shred ‘em, slice ‘em or, as I’ve done in this recipe: blend ‘em! 

These stuffed pasta shells are filled with a creamy tofu-cashew ricotta, baked in a garlicky tomato sauce, and pack 31g of protein per serving 💪

The recipe is from my new cookbook, Simply Plants (out in just 4 days - eek!!) but I've also shared a FREE preview on our website so you can try it already! Just search for ‘stuffed pasta’ on pickuplimes
